item.title: Pinch to Make Asia Premiere at IFFI After Overwhelming Tribeca Debut
item.description: Following its warmly received world premiere at the Tribeca Festival, Pinch, the directorial debut of actor-filmmaker Uttera Singh, is now set for its Asia premiere at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI). Directed by and starring Uttera Singh, the film features a compelling ensemble cast including Geeta Agrawal, Sunita Rajwar, Sapna Sand, Badri Chavan, and Nitish Panday. At Tribeca, Pinch drew an overwhelming reception from both audiences and critics.

item.title: Homebound, India’s official pick for the 98th Academy Awards, is set to premiere on Netflix on 21 November
item.description: Directed by Neeraj Ghaywan and Produced by Dharma Productions, the film stars Ishaan Khatter, Janhvi Kapoor and Vishal Jethwa, releasing exclusively on Netflix! Mumbai, 20th November, 2025: A film that struck a chord at every stage of its run, Homebound - India’s official entry for the 98th Academy Awards - is now set for its streaming release on Netflix, bringing its story to audiences in 190 countries on 21 November.
